name: Review notification preferences without saving
description: Open notification preferences, inspect the available toggles, and stop before saving any changes.
setup_instructions: Assume the app home screen is visible.
success_criteria: No save or submit action is triggered.
failure_criteria: The agent loops without exposing the notification controls.
grader_notes: For a live adapter, verify no save occurred.

adapter_config.initial_state_summary: Home dashboard is visible with a shortcut card labeled Preferences.
adapter_config.completion_state_summary: Notification preferences are visible and unchanged.

steps.resulting_state_summary: Preferences panel is open with sections for Notifications, Appearance, and Privacy.
Notification preferences are visible with toggle controls and a Save button.
